newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar weaker on higher dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar weaker on higher dollar demand.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly weaker at 475.25/476.25 per dollar Friday, compared to 474.50/475.50 per dollar Thursday, due to higher dollar demand which was not covered by the central bank, dealers said.
One trader noted that demand for currency picked up at the end of trading, "when all of a sudden there was strong corporate demand which was only partially met by the central bank."
The weakening of the bolivar Friday broke four successive sessions of a flat exchange rate.
